title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E12 — Strange Machines
From the kitchen to the battlefield, some machines are just too strange to believe; like an appliance that runs on pup power; or a mousetrap so deadly, you need a permit to own one; how about a submarine car straight out of a Bond movie?

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E13 — Unimaginable Disasters
A drilling accident tears open the Earth and unleashes a fire pit known as the "Gates of Hell"; a routine flight turns harrowing when the pilot gets sucked out of the cockpit midair; a ship mishap sinks 4,000 luxury cars into the Atlantic.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E20 — Most Shocking Dances With Death
What drives someone to gamble with their own life? From a French tailor who leaps off the Eiffel Tower to a man struck by lightning more times than should be humanly possible, these perilous wagers with death are as shocking as they are unbelievable.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E14 — Out of this World
From a piece of the International Space Station crashing into a Florida home, to the first chimpanzee blasted into space, to a mind-bending time slip experienced by two women in Versailles.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E15 — When Darkness Falls
When the sun sets, strange things come alive; imagine a full-scale war waged against thousands of invading frogs, an artist who only paints while sleepwalking, and battlefield wounds that literally glow in the dark.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E16 — Unlikely Heroes
How did a pet pig spring into action to save its owner's life? Which mysterious spirits became the unlikely heroes that turned the tide for a doomed flight? And what shocking move did a carjacker make to rescue a baby trapped in a scorching car?

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E09 — The Amazing Events of the Book of Exodus
The Burning Bush, the 10 Plagues, the Parting of the Red Sea these Biblical events in the Book of Exodus have shaped Judeo-Christian beliefs for centuries.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E13 — The Search for Noah's Ark
It's one of the most famous stories from the Bible; for thousands of years the tale of Noah's Ark is shared, but little is known about what happened to the ark.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S05 E02 — The Garden of Eden
Most people know it as the biblical birthplace of man -- the Garden of Eden; investigating if the Garden of Eden was just a story to explain human creation or if it was a real place.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S05 E04 — The Shroud of Turin
The haunting image of the Shroud of Turin has captivated millions around the world; scientists and theologians are trying to figure out if the Shroud of Turin truly is an image of Jesus or something very different.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E15 — The Legend of Bigfoot
Thousands of people swear they've encountered the legendary North American creature Bigfoot, but Bigfoot has never been officially identified; as evidence continues to mount, and photos are scrutinized, the mystery endures.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S03 E03 — The Dyatlov Pass Incident
An infamous Cold War cold case involving nine hikers found mutilated on a remote mountain slope; for over 60 years, authorities and amateurs alike have been trying to figure out what happened in a place that's been called "Russia's Area 51."

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E20 — Lost Places of the Old Testament
The Tower of Babel, Sodom and Gomorrah, and Mount Sinai have seemingly vanished from the map; where are the Old Testament's legendary lost places, and what might they reveal?

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E02 — Who Is the Zodiac Killer?
In 1969, a serial killer taunts investigators with cryptic ciphers, leaving police and the public questioning his identity for over 50 years; new evidence and technology may finally be able to crack his code and discover who the Zodiac Killer is.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E03 — The Valentine's Day Massacre
The Valentine's Day Massacre, a shocking event in Chicago's history, occurred on February 14th, 1929; it's an unsolved mystery.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S02 E02 — Hunting Hitler's U-Boats
An investigation into the unshakable claims of a treasure hunter.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S03 E01 — The Amber Room
One of World War II's greatest unsolved mysteries: an incomparable work of art worth half a billion dollars, lost without a trace; perhaps the single most valuable object the Nazis ever stole, the quest for this treasure has lasted over 75 years.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E11 — The Hunt for Stolen Nazi Treasure
During World War Two, the Nazis stole vast amounts of art, gold, silver and currency, and stashed it across Europe; while some of the plunder has been recovered, much more is still missing nearly 80 years later.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E22 — The Hunt for Hitler
The history books say Adolf Hitler committed suicide in the final days of World War II, but not everyone believes there's sufficient proof; questions have swirled for decades about his possible escape.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E23 — The Lost Gold of WWII
During World War II, Japan plunders a fortune worth hundreds of billions of dollars from occupied countries, but to this day its whereabouts are unknown.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S07 E14 — Foo Fighters
During World War II, a phenomenon terrorizes American airmen in the night skies over Europe; the pilots call these fireballs foo fighters, and swear they move at over 200 mph and defy the laws of physics; but what are they?

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S07 E15 — The Search for Rommel's Gold
General Erwin Rommel tears through North Africa; he steals gold and valuables in the name of the Führer; but when the allies surrender, that wealth is nowhere to be found.
